choice: PEM self-clinching nut or stud (row sheet)
because:
- a clinched thread holds in sheet softer than the fastener by about 20 HRB, in a hole +0.08/-0 mm, with the press reaching both faces [ref:pem-handbook]

runner-up: through-bolt and nut; wins when: ?
gap: no registry source ranks a PEM against a loose nut and bolt in sheet; the runner-up is listed, not ranked
gap: insert_fits not computed: the insert capacity model is calibrated on FDM prints only, not sheet-metal
